channel.title: Hartford Business Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hartford Business Journal (hartfordbusiness.com)

item.title: 🔒 Former Bob’s Discount Furniture location in Newington sells for $2.37M
item.description: A two-story retail building along the busy Berlin Turnpike that housed the first Bob’s Discount Furniture store beginning in 1991 recently sold for $2.37 million.

item.title: 🔒 266-unit affordable housing proposal in Glastonbury set for public hearing
item.description: A public hearing will take place next week on a developer’s proposal to build a 266-unit apartment complex along Griswold and Main streets in Glastonbury.

item.title: Sheraton Hartford Hotel at Bradley Airport completes multimillion-dollar renovation
item.description: The Sheraton Hartford Hotel at Bradley Airport has completed a multimillion-dollar overhaul of its public spaces, funded by the hotel’s ownership group with financing from Liberty Bank, officials announced Thursday.

item.title: 🔒 CT fines repeat-offender debt collector $140K, orders consumer refunds
item.description: A Utah debt collection company that previously reached a settlement with Connecticut regulators was hit with a $100,000 civil penalty and ordered to refund consumers after violating the terms of that agreement within months of signing it, state records show.

item.title: Hartford proposes 6-month moratorium on smoke shops, tobacco retailers
item.description: Hartford officials are considering a temporary six-month moratorium on new or expanded smoke shops, smoking lounges and retail tobacco sales, citing public health and enforcement concerns.

item.title: 🔒 CT PE firm raises $5.4B fund targeting supply chain, industrial companies
item.description: A Greenwich-based private equity firm has raised $5.4 billion for its newest investment vehicle, exceeding its original target and marking the largest fund in the firm’s history. Greenbriar Equity Group […]

item.title: CT legislature’s Tax Equity Caucus lists priorities, including tax increases on the wealthy
item.description: Imposing a surcharge on capital gains and dividends for the wealthiest taxpayers and raising the top marginal tax rate by a percentage point are among the top priorities of the legislature’s Tax Equity Caucus for the 2026 session of the state General Assembly.

item.title: 🔒 CT tourism chiefs target marketing budget as an election issue
item.description: A study, to be unveiled in September, will estimate the economic impact of tourism in the state.

item.title: 🔒 Tariff volatility disrupts CT manufacturer’s sales despite higher earnings
item.description: Tariff volatility and shifting federal trade policy disrupted customer orders at Acme United Corp. in 2025, tempering sales growth.

item.title: Mixed-use Stamford office-apartment tower sells for $25M
